statement.p: (a) The annual inflation rate is 3.7% per year. If a movie ticket costs $10.00 today, find a formula for p, the price of a movie ticket t years from today, assuming that movie tickets keep up with inflation.
(b) According to your formula, how much will a movie ticket cost in 30 years?

static.solution:
SOLUTION
(a) We assume that the price of a movie ticket increases at the rate of 3.7% per year. This means that the price is rising exponentially, so a formula for p is of the form p=ab^t. We have a=10.00 and b=1+r=1.037. Thus, a formula for p is p = 10.00(1.037)^t.
(b) In 30 years t=30 we have p = 10.00(1.037)^{30} \approx 29.74.
